_comment: Fishing grounds. Where trawlers are allowed to fish. Edit to expand the fleet's range. Anything not on these lists is out of bounds — the fleet does NOT explore relatedness, recommended channels, or recursive crawling.
out_of_bounds: Wikipedia-style summaries about Kiriakou (we want HIM speaking, not ABOUT him)
Clip channels reposting short cuts of existing long-form (handled by dedup, but flag if title looks derivative)
Anything where Kiriakou is only briefly mentioned by a third party — those go to bycatch, not fresh catch
